purpose: Let a canonical Product Twin retain durable external identity references without caching mutable source catalog payloads.

external_reference.reference_type: catalog_product | merchant_product | variant | manufacturer_sku | gtin | bim_object | geometry_asset | supplier_item | other

verification.method: gtin | manufacturer_sku | exact_model | merchant_mapping | manual | other

allowed_persistence: stable product/variant reference needed for later lookup
shopify_policy.principle: Resolve mutable Shopify Catalog fields live with lookup_catalog/get_product when the reference is used; do not use GitHub or Product Twin as a Shopify catalog cache.
